user.title: Set up HA Health-O-Mat
user.description: Create one person. Add the integration again for each additional person.

data.lifetime_start_ml: Lifetime counter start value in ml

init.title: Health-O-Mat options
init.description: Choose a section for {person}. Settings are only applied after saving in the summary.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: Daily goal, lifetime counter, display name, daily reset, retention, sidebar panel and tracked areas.

drinks.title: Drinks
drinks.description: Preset drinks and drink dictionary for {person}.

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing images
wellbeing.description: Optional own image per wellbeing level. Enter an image URL, a /local/... path or a file name below /config/www/ (PNG, JPG or WebP). Leave empty to use the emoji.

notifications.title: Reminders and weekly report
notifications.description: All notifications are off by default. An empty notify service sends a persistent notification inside Home Assistant.

data.reminder_drink_goal: Remind when the daily goal is not reached
data.reminder_no_drink_hours: Remind after X hours without a drink (0 = off)
data.reminder_bp_days: Remind if blood pressure was not measured for X days (0 = off)
data.reminder_wellbeing_days: Remind if wellbeing was not reported for X days (0 = off)
data.weekly_report_notify_service: Notify service for the weekly report

data_description.reminders_enabled: Sends one bundled reminder per selected day, at most once per condition.
data_description.reminder_days: Monday is the first day of the week.
data_description.reminder_notify_service: Name of a notify service, with or without the notify. prefix. Empty = persistent notification.
data_description.reminder_quiet_start: No reminders inside this window. Supports midnight rollover (e.g. 22:00 to 07:00).
data_description.reminder_quiet_end: End of the quiet window. Both bounds are required for a quiet window.
data_description.reminder_drink_goal: Reminds while today's amount is below the daily goal.
data_description.reminder_no_drink_hours: Reminds when the last active drink is older than this many hours.
data_description.reminder_bp_days: Reminds when no blood pressure reading was recorded within this many days.
data_description.reminder_wellbeing_days: Reminds when no wellbeing report was recorded within this many days.
data_description.weekly_report_enabled: Sends the last seven days as a Markdown notification.
data_description.weekly_report_day: Day of the week for the report.
data_description.weekly_report_notify_service: Name of a notify service, with or without the notify. prefix. Empty = persistent notification.

defaults.title: Use defaults
defaults.description: Applies preset drinks, the built-in drink dictionary, no custom images and notifications off. Nothing is saved until you confirm in the summary.

summary.title: Summary

add_drink.name: Add drink
add_drink.description: Books a drink amount for a person.

ts.name: Timestamp
ts.description: Time of the entry (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:30 or with offset). Empty = now. At most 5 minutes in the future, not before 1900.

add_blood_pressure.name: Save blood pressure reading
add_blood_pressure.description: Stores systolic/diastolic values and optional pulse.

ts.name: Timestamp
ts.description: Time of the entry (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:30 or with offset). Empty = now. At most 5 minutes in the future, not before 1900.

set_wellbeing.name: Report wellbeing
set_wellbeing.description: Reports the current wellbeing of a person by key or numeric score (1–10).

person.name: Person
person.description: Person name (empty = the only configured person).

status.name: Status
status.description: Wellbeing key: very_bad, awful, bad, poor, okay, mixed, good, very_good, great or excellent.

score.name: Score
score.description: Numeric wellbeing score from 1 (very bad) to 10 (excellent). Alternative to status.

ts.name: Timestamp
ts.description: Time of the entry (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:30 or with offset). Empty = now. At most 5 minutes in the future, not before 1900.

remove_last_entry.name: Remove last entry
remove_last_entry.description: Removes the last active drink, blood-pressure or wellbeing entry (undo). The entry stays restorable.

person.name: Person
person.description: Person name (empty = the only configured person).

kind.name: Type
kind.description: Which entry to remove: drinks (default), blood_pressure or wellbeing.

void_entry.name: Delete entry
void_entry.description: Marks a single entry as deleted (not a hard delete). The entry stays restorable.

person.name: Person
person.description: Person name (empty = the only configured person).

kind.name: Type
kind.description: Entry type: drinks, blood_pressure or wellbeing.

restore_entry.name: Restore entry
restore_entry.description: Clears the deletion marker of an entry.

person.name: Person
person.description: Person name (empty = the only configured person).

kind.name: Type
kind.description: Entry type: drinks, blood_pressure or wellbeing.

id.name: Entry ID
id.description: Entry ID of the deleted entry from the history.

export_csv.name: CSV export
export_csv.description: Exports data as Excel-friendly CSV to /config/health_o_mat_export/. Administrators only.

dataset.name: Dataset
dataset.description: Which data to export: drinks, blood_pressure, lab_values or all.

import_csv.name: CSV import
import_csv.description: Imports drinks or blood-pressure data from /config/health_o_mat_import/ (this folder only, never /config/www).

person.name: Person
person.description: Target person (empty = the only configured person).

dataset.name: Dataset
dataset.description: Which data to import: drinks, blood_pressure, lab_values or all (auto-detect).

backup.name: Backup
backup.description: Writes a JSON backup of all persons and datasets to /config/health_o_mat_export/. Administrators only.

restore_backup.name: Restore backup
restore_backup.description: Restores a JSON backup from /config/health_o_mat_import/ or /config/health_o_mat_export/ (merge or replace, optionally limited to persons, datasets and a time range). A safety backup is written before any change. Administrators only.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: File name inside /config/health_o_mat_import/ or /config/health_o_mat_export/ (JSON files only).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Merge adds entries (duplicates are skipped); replace clears the selected scope first and requires the REPLACE confirmation.

persons.name: Persons
persons.description: Only restore these persons (source slug, source entry ID or target entry ID; empty = all).

from.name: From (ISO)
from.description: Only entries at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

to.name: To (ISO)
to.description: Only entries at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

person_map.name: Person mapping
person_map.description: Mapping from a source to a target entry ID. Required when the person cannot be matched unambiguously by name. Persons are never created automatically.

restore_audit.name: Import audit log
restore_audit.description: Also import the backup audit log (experts only; by default only new restore events are written).

weekly_report.name: Send weekly report
weekly_report.description: Sends the last seven days as one Markdown notification per person (no file export).

person.name: Person
person.description: Person name (empty = every configured person gets their own report).

add_lab_value.name: Record lab value
add_lab_value.description: Stores a lab value (catalog or custom marker) for a person.

marker.name: Marker
marker.description: Stable marker key (e.g. alt, creatinine, crp) or a custom marker key from the admin panel. German lab synonyms (gpt, got, gamma_gt) are resolved automatically.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the value (optional, defaults to the marker's canonical unit). Required for markers with a known mix-up risk (e.g. the urine protein/creatinine ratio).

ts.name: Timestamp
ts.description: Time of the entry (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:30 or with offset). Empty = now. At most 5 minutes in the future, not before 1900.

report_ref.name: Report reference
report_ref.description: Optional link or external ID of the lab report (max 500 characters). Reference only, Health-O-Mat never fetches the URL itself.

remove_last_lab_value.name: Remove last lab value
remove_last_lab_value.description: Removes the last active lab value of a given marker (undo). The entry is marked deleted and stays restorable.

marker.name: Marker
marker.description: Stable marker key whose last value is removed.
